[F001] All four findings addressed; targeted tests pass (23/23) and the broader dashboard+projects suite is green (133/133). The existing task list is from unrelated projects, so no TaskCreate updates are warranted for this implementer scope.

**Finding 1 (cache layout)** — Reverted the nested `state/` subdir: `projects_dashboard.build_project_state` now writes `state-snapshot.json`, `what-now.json`, `manifest.json`, `architecture-status.json`, `reconcile-status.json`, etc. directly under `~/.dontpanic/dashboard/projects/<name>/` per plan §Data Shape. Fleet-summary `_fleet_entry` now reads snapshot/what-now from the cache dir directly; legacy `state_dir` is gone. Tests updated to match the flat layout (line 124 and inactive-skip at line 316).

**Finding 2 (global-cache last-project-wins)** — Added `capabilities_cache_path` and `what_now_cache_path_override` parameters to `dashboard.build()` (the local var was renamed to avoid shadowing). `projects_dashboard.build_project_state` now passes per-project paths (`capabilities-required.json` and `what-now-cache.json` inside the project's cache dir), so per-project builds never overwrite the operator-global `~/.dontpanic/capabilities-status.json` or `~/.dontpanic/dashboard/what-now.json` that single-repo mode owns. New regression test `test_per_project_build_does_not_clobber_global_caches` asserts both globals stay non-existent after two project builds.
